d: Bihar ki rajdhani patna men aaj us vakt prashasnik amle men harkanp mach gaya jab rajy bhar ke band pare 1,731 kushal yuva karyakram (KYP) kendron ke sanchalak aur chhatr achanak mukhyamantri aavas ka gherav karne pahunch gae. pradarshankariyon ne jila prashasan se gandhi maidan men shantipurn pradarshan aur diem karyalay tak march ki anumti li thi, lekin gupt raste se ve patna zu (chiriyakhana) ke get nanbar 2 tak pahunch gae, jahan se mukhyamantri aavas ki duri mahaj 200 mitar hai. jaise hi pradarshankari siem aavas ki taraph 100 mitar aage barhe, pulis ne tatparta dikhate hue unhen rok…
